# C&S Demolition

> C&S Demolition (DBA of Scrapit LLC) is a California-licensed demolition contractor (License #1126325) serving 123+ cities across Southern California — Orange County, Los Angeles County, Riverside County, and San Bernardino County. We specialize in residential and commercial demolition including interior demo, concrete breaking, garage teardown, and more. Written lump-sum bids. Licensed and insured, with a $100,000 LLC worker bond on file with CSLB. Phone: (562) 204-6335. Email: contactus@cnsdemo.com.

## Services

- [Interior Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/interior-demolition) — Selective interior demo for kitchens, bathrooms, walls, and full gut-outs. Written lump-sum bid.
- [Whole House Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/whole-house-demolition) — Complete structure teardown including foundation options. Written lump-sum bid.
- [Concrete Removal](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/concrete-removal) — Driveways, slabs, patios, walkways. Written lump-sum bid.
- [Garage Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/garage-demolition) — Attached or detached garage teardown. Written lump-sum bid.
- [Deck Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/deck-demolition) — Wood, composite, or concrete deck removal. Written lump-sum bid.
- [Wall Removal](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/wall-removal) — Load-bearing and non-load-bearing wall removal. Written lump-sum bid.
- [Shed Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/shed-demolition) — Small and large outbuilding teardown. Written lump-sum bid.
- [Commercial Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/commercial-demolition) — Office buildouts, retail teardowns, industrial sites. Written lump-sum bid.
- [Kitchen Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/kitchen-demolition) — Full kitchen gut including cabinets, flooring, fixtures. Written lump-sum bid.
- [Bathroom Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/bathroom-demolition) — Tile, fixtures, vanities, walls. Written lump-sum bid.
- [Chimney Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/chimney-demolition) — Partial or full chimney and fireplace removal. Written lump-sum bid.
- [Mobile Home Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/mobile-home-demolition) — Manufactured home teardown and site clearing. Written lump-sum bid.
- [Fence Removal](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/fence-removal) — Wood, block, chain-link removal. Written lump-sum bid.
- [Driveway Removal](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/driveway-removal) — Concrete or asphalt driveway demolition. Written lump-sum bid.

## Company Facts

- Legal name: SCRAPIT, LLC (DBA: C&S Demolition)
- CA Contractor License: #1126325 (verifiable at cslb.ca.gov)
- General liability + workers' compensation insurance on every project
- Based in Anaheim, CA 92807
- Service area: Southern California (4 counties, 123+ cities)
- Phone: (562) 204-6335
- Email: contactus@cnsdemo.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 7AM–6PM, Sat 8AM–4PM
- Pricing model: Lump-sum only, no hourly billing
- Every bid spells out scope, haul-away, cleanup, exclusions, and who pulls permits
- Founded 2014 by owner Tony; four-person crew
- Certified California Small Business (Micro), SB ID 2046111
